INFORMED CONSENT FORM
Moderna, Inc. Sponsored Clinical Research

Study Title: A Phase 3 Study of mRNA-1273 for the Prevention of COVID-19
Protocol Number: PROT-8873-57
Sponsor: Moderna, Inc.
Principal Investigator: Julia Shaw, MD
Institution: Port Lisahaven Medical Center
ICF Version: v5.0
Date: 25 August 2026
Introduction
You are being asked to participate in a research study. Before you decide, it is important for you to understand why the research is being done and what it will involve. Please read the following information carefully and discuss it with others if you wish. Ask us if there is anything that is not clear or if you would like more information. Take time to decide whether or not you wish to take part.
Purpose of the Study
The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of an investigational vaccine/medicine being developed by Moderna, Inc.. This study is being conducted under an Investigational New Drug (IND) application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
What Will Happen to Me?
If you agree to participate, you will receive up to 4 doses of study medication and will be asked to attend 6 clinic visits over approximately 16 months. At each visit, you may have blood tests, physical examinations, and questionnaires about your health.
Possible Risks and Discomforts
Injection site reactions (redness, swelling, pain) — very common, usually mild and temporary
Fatigue, headache, muscle aches — common, usually resolve within 1-3 days
Fever — common after dose 2, usually resolves within 24-48 hours
Allergic reactions — rare, medical team is prepared to treat immediately
Unknown risks — as with any investigational product, there may be unforeseen risks
Possible Benefits
You may or may not directly benefit from participation. However, the information gathered may help develop treatments that benefit others in the future.
Confidentiality
Your personal information will be kept confidential. Data will be coded and your name will not appear in any publications. Records may be inspected by FDA, IRB, and Moderna, Inc. for quality oversight purposes.
Voluntary Participation
Participation in this study is completely voluntary. You may withdraw at any time without penalty or loss of benefits to which you are otherwise entitled.
